run_build_all_targets: run the task runner to build all gRPC test and artifact targets
run_build_selected_targets: run the task runner with -b flag to build specific named targets or labels
run_build_with_filter: run the task runner with -f flag to filter targets by label with AND semantics
run_build_parallel_jobs: run the task runner with -j flag to set the number of parallel build jobs
run_build_travis_mode: run the task runner with -t flag to enable Travis CI mode
